reviews.text: The advice and lessons with Fabiana were fantastic; they have helped us a lot with Caju and, above all, have given us the confidence that we are on the right track.
Fabi is a sweetheart, she has helped us adapt our puppy to our home, and she takes the time to answer all our questions.

Pol has been a huge help with our dog. After more than a year of seeing five different ethologists and trainers, we couldn't get her to walk us peacefully in the street or have a good relationship with her at home (she barely let us do anything).

With Pol, although we still have some work to do on our end, in less than two weeks we can already enjoy walks and a good relationship at home. We would definitely choose him again!

We’ve worked with Fabiana for a couple of weeks to understand why our French Bulldog gets so excited when meeting people and to help her regulate her feelings. Fabiana is an amazing dog trainer who understood our dog right away and explained everything so clearly. She gave concrete homework and we‘re super happy with the progress we’re making. We will definitely work with her again and can only recommend her!

We've noticed a big change in Kira.
She's serious, punctual, and affectionate.
Kira and we will always be grateful.
Lovely experience. Arthion helped us with resolving the biggest issues with our dog in just 4 sessions. Flexible with location and time. Great experience overall. Thank you!

We are very happy with the results we've achieved thanks to Christopher's work. He is a very empathetic professional, and the training techniques he taught us have been truly effective. Our dog's behavior on walks has improved tremendously, and now our walks are much calmer and more enjoyable. We highly recommend him!

Christopher has been a great help to us and our dog. Always very kind, patient, and professional, he dedicated quality time to each session. His advice and tools have allowed us to correct our dog's behavior effectively and quickly. We are very happy with the results. Highly recommended!

I hired Christopher to work on Sura's behavior modification, and the results far exceeded my expectations. From the very first moment, he exuded confidence and professionalism, and it was clear he truly understands canine behavior. The techniques he used were effective and, above all, respectful of Sura. Seeing my dog's transformation has been incredible.

If you're looking for a trainer who is truly committed and delivers results, look no further: Christopher is the one. Highly recommended!

We had three sessions with Christopher to give us advice with our mini pinscher puppy. Christopher is polite, patient and knowledgeable and gave us exercises and advice that we could act on ourselves between and after the sessions.
Christopher was very kind, and all the exercises he gives to us worked a lot !! We recommend him !! 👍🏻 …

Really happy with the services of Christopher!

We like his professionalism and how clear he is explaining what to do with our little puppy! He always follows up and gives us exercises to do a-synch while waiting for the next meeting. We definitely recommend him to help you with your dogs! You can trust him!
We've had 3 sessions with Christopher and it was excellent! He's able to solve all kinds of problems, all with kindness! I highly recommend him!

We adopted Achilles, a mastiff mix, with some self-control issues. With the help of Christopher, who helped us follow guidelines both at home and on walks, we've noticed that the bond is much stronger.

We took classes with Christopher. He was very available and had a very positive approach with our Gala. We saw good results after just a few sessions (now we can go out more relaxed and Gala stays still in the restaurant while we eat). I recommend him :)
Christopher has been very kind and helpful in training Socks. His exercises have helped us manage his anxiety and start controlling his walks. Highly recommended!
Hi Monica, thank you very much for your feedback.

Hello, we wanted to share our experience with Michael for training our dog Vlad (American Bully XL).
It was very instructive for both us and our dog because he listened carefully to our concerns regarding our dog's issues (destruction, recall, etc.).
A very good trainer; we highly recommend him.

It was a pleasure having Christopher work with us and the dogs. We had a lot of difficulty welcoming a 9-year-old dog into our home, a dog who was somewhat traumatized, especially since we already had another dog of the same age. Christopher's advice had an immediate impact on reducing tension between the dogs and in the house. In a short time, the dogs were living together respectfully and even showing signs of enjoying each other's company. I definitely recommend Christopher.

Great experience with Christofer! The exercises were very interesting and worked really well.
Thank you so much for your help!

We highly recommend Christopher and Perro Sano! We recently completed a series of three training sessions for our puppy, starting when he was just 4.5 months old, and the results have been fantastic. While our puppy wasn’t particularly difficult, we wanted to address a few specific behaviors, and thanks to Christopher’s guidance, he has now become an amazing dog!

Christopher is patient, extremely knowledgeable, and always willing to assist with any questions we had—whether during the sessions or through WhatsApp. His support made all the difference, and we couldn’t be happier with the progress. Thank you so much, Christopher!

My experience has been fantastic. In my case, the sessions were with Christopher. My dog, Tom, was very reactive with other dogs; taking him for walks was incredibly stressful—he would pull and bark. Tom had spent nine years living in the countryside, and the city was stressful for him. We managed to get him used to noises, but we thought his sociability with other dogs was lost. We decided to contact a trainer, and it was a complete success. With Christopher, we saw results in the very first session. We followed his guidelines, and after three days of walks, Tom was a completely different dog. Now I can go out calmly, without anxiety, without constantly looking over my shoulder to make sure no other dog appears. I can finally enjoy walks. Thank you so much, Christopher, for your patience, kindness, and professionalism. We will continue to follow your advice. Best regards.

We had three sessions with Mike and everything went extremely well! He's patient and takes his time with the puppy.
I recommend him 100%!
We reached out to Mike for our dog Obi and his reactivity issues. We were put in touch with Chris. …

I wanted to share my experience with Mike, who was an invaluable help with our two slightly spoiled little dogs. Thanks to his wise advice, we learned to better understand their behavior and train them positively. Mike showed us the …

In just 3 sessions, he managed to: integrate a puppy with ours, work on their attachment, socialize the new puppy who didn't know how, and socialize Cuca, who was always barking. We wanted to get a 10-session package, but he told us the 3-session package was very effective. So, he was honest too. Highly recommended!

We've had three sessions with our two dogs and the change is amazing! We've worked on their separation anxiety and jealousy issues. One of the dogs had been with another behaviorist before, and Mike has done much better with fewer sessions. Highly recommended!

Chris is truely professional and attentive Dog Trainer, he manage to find some tools to alert Milki when he is misbehaving, I wish I had more time for practice with Chris as we are leaving Spain, Thank you Chris

Christopher has been a great help to us. In just three sessions, he's taught us the key aspects that Jäger needs. We're very happy, and now we just need to put them into practice. He also shows interest and asks us how he's progressing. Highly recommended, thank you for everything!
I loved the experience! In my case, the session was with trainer Christopher, and we were truly amazed by the changes and corrections he achieved with my dog! Thank you so much! 💪 …
